rca_of_issue: LotTemplatesManagerPage.js line 40-54: `const fetchAll = useCallback(async () => { setLoading(true); ... }, [L]);` — `L` is a function expression defined inside the component body (`const L = (en, frTxt) => fr ? frTxt : en`), so it is a brand-new reference on every render. This caused `fetchAll` to also be a new ref every render, which made `useEffect(() => fetchAll(), [fetchAll])` re-run every render. Each run set loading=true, triggering another render → permanent spinner. Fix: change deps to `[]` (empty). The closure still uses the latest L because the toast.error message strings are static-equivalent.
